name: axHub passes
author: Brett
description: The hub's passes inside the console: the Go pass (one pass for a whole session: rules, threads, repos) and timed veto passes (what each covers, time left, revoke, the calls that ran under it), through the console's hub-pages relay with a hub session. Module axHub (the hub's own pages inside the console, folded from apps/axhub-web Nov 20 2026). Only a wall admin's browser may use it; uninstalling it removes only these pages.
